title: This is what actually happens in your body when your sick
author: indiegatsu
selftext:
Hi, Bio-Shooter is an online FPS/TPS based in the Human body. Play as the Medicine or the Germ, play alone or with friends, and climb the ranks! 

You can gain up to 100 Ranks with Prestige coming after launch, create your own emblems, unlock attachments, player cards and titles, and play 3 game modes and 3 maps during early access. 

Let me know what you think, Early Access begins November 6th so be sure to wishlist! :D 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5465060/BioShooter/
